_comment: A request/response pair for POST /api/cookie-consent, replayed through the
endpoint's own request validator: `request.body` parses clean and
`rejected.body` is the shape @medalsocial/sdk 1.10.0 was TYPED to send. Replayed
through the same validator it produces `rejected.error` — a 400 on every call. That
is the bug this fixture exists to pin: the SDK's types and the wire format had
drifted apart, and nothing in the test suite compared them.
`request.body.timestamp` is fixed here for a byte-stable comparison. The endpoint
accepts a timestamp up to 5 minutes ahead and up to 7 days old, so this value is
only meaningful as bytes; the SDK does not validate the window.

body.consentText: We use essential cookies to run this site and optional cookies only with your consent.

rejected.error: Invalid event. Must be one of: preferences_saved, preferences_revoked, banner_displayed, preferences_expired
